svg.title: TOPAK H8 — The command-chain overlay's evidence: eight TLA+ modules, checked and proved, and what each says against its record
svg.desc: ADR-0059 to ADR-0066 each ask, in their ratification condition, for a module that states the properties and mutations that break them (ADR-0046's method). On 2026.11.10 eight were written from those conditions and proposal §10 of derived/topak-federated-c2-design-proposal-2026.11.10b.md, model-checked by TLC (321 rows, all as expected), proved by the TLA+ Proof System (5,600 obligations) and certified, with 52 LS4 temporal steps that no checker confirms. Each header states findings against its record, and the same day R1 revised ADR-0059 to ADR-0067 to take them: the module items of ADR-0059 to ADR-0066 now read "Met for TLC and TLAPS" and cite every file by digest. Every record is Proposed, an overlay and not the archetype, and nothing here is built: no floor stage is written, the reference has no addendum, and none of these words is a claim about running code. Every count and digest on this page is read from the files when the diagram is generated.
svg.text: TOPAK · H8

text.tspan: The command-chain overlay's evidence: eight TLA+ modules, checked and proved, and what each says against its record

svg.text: ADR-0059 to ADR-0066 each ask, in their ratification condition, for a module that states the properties and mutations that break them (ADR-0046's method). On 2026.11.10 eight were written from those conditions and proposal §10 of derived/topak-federated-c2-design-proposal-2026.11.10b.md, model-checked by TLC (321 rows, all as expected), proved by the TLA+ Proof System (5,600 obligations) and certified, with 52 LS4 temporal steps that no checker confirms.

Each header states findings against its record, and the same day R1 revised ADR-0059 to ADR-0067 to take them: the module items of ADR-0059 to ADR-0066 now read "Met for TLC and TLAPS" and cite every file by digest. Every record is Proposed, an overlay and not the archetype, and nothing here is built: no floor stage is written, the reference has no addendum, and none of these words is a claim about running code. Every count and digest on this page is read from the
files when the diagram is generated.

no record ratified · nothing in force
nothing here is checked, proved or certified of running code (T-0045-28)

svg.text: Three words, kept apart (ADR-0046 §1, A1). TLC checks each module at small constants: every mutation fails the property it targets and holds the rest, every Never… witness is violated, Safe holds. The prover proves each invariant under its named hypotheses (the mutations it excludes and the module's ASSUMEs) for every constant they admit. A proof module is certified when every obligation is closed by tlapm's normalization or a checked proof, except its LS4 temporal steps, which no checker confirms; and a certified proof is not a

verified one (ADR-0046 A2, B37). Proposed means nothing here is in force. The modules and the revision are the drafter's, one author, one day; every record's last condition, a reader who is not the drafter, is not met.

Obligation counts equal the ordinary runs' (<M>-proof-results-2026.11.10.txt, each ending "All N obligations proved", under Z3); the certified run adds none and removes none. Each proof is for every value of the constants its assumptions admit: "the prover, not the constants, bounds the claim" (every proof results file). Mutations and witnesses are behaviours and stay with TLC. A deadlock line claims only that at its constants every terminal state is at the module's own bound, so -deadlock hides nothing else; it claims nothing under a
mutation or at other constants.
Every file by digest (SHA-256, first 16 hex, computed here) against the digest the record's ratification condition cites ⟨R1⟩

35 rows · 677 obligations · 5 LS4: as the files

Every digest is the one the record cites, and every figure the record states is the files'. Each TLC results file also names its module by digest, and each matches. The R1 module items cite them (ADR-0059 §9 to ADR-0066 §7), and spec/README.md says so.
Why: the pinned prover is known to be unsound in two ways (ADR-0046 A2, B37): a term under a binder, and two terms that share a name. The scan looks; it does not
Runs: 8 proof modules rerun, 8 certify. 28 SMT queries hold an opaque constant under a binder, listed by line; the scan's rule is that this is the binder case only when the
hidden term mentions a variable bound around it, and the step at each line says which. 8 obligations were closed by Zenon or Isabelle.
Names: a second run over sources with 1,951 identifiers renamed: 0 of 8 differ (0.0017 collisions expected by accident).
Capture: 1,766 obligations printed normalized: 0 captures; SANY parses 8 of 8.
Why: every run passes TLC's -deadlock, which turns off the report of a state with no successor. The audit asks whether that hides anything.
8 lines, one per module, unmutated, at the results files' constants: 6 have no terminal state; 2 (Membership, Outstanding) have terminal states only at the module's own
bound; 0 stray deadlocks.
Membership's bound is every honest replica having voted from every reached membership: a vote that splits stalls the schedule, which R1 put in ADR-0061 §3, its Negatives
and its open obligations.
It does not claim the module never stalls: a state whose only step leaves it unchanged has a successor, and neither TLC's check nor ENABLED sees it.

text.tspan: Beyond proposal §10, read from its table

svg.text: Proposal §10 names 30 mutations. The modules run 46, of which 16 §10 does not name; each is marked in section 3, and every one §10 names is run.
Headers call some added: M_OFFSCHEDULE, M_TWOVOTES ("beyond §7's two"), M_LASTINTENT ("an addition to proposal §10's table"), M_NOSTOP, M_ORDEREDFREE ("Added:
finding 3", "finding 1"). Records call others added: M_TOOSLOW and NoStretchUnlessSlow (ADR-0064 §8); NarrowsInReceived (ADR-0065 §9); OrderedInContact,
M_ANYVEHICLE, M_NOCONTACT, M_OBSCOUPLE, M_AGENTPROPOSES (ADR-0066 §7).
OneSuccessor is in Membership.tla where §10 puts it under Federation: it rests on quorum intersection and shares no state with the charter chain (spec/README.md).

text.tspan: 3 · Each module whole: every property with the theorem that proves it, every mutation with the rows it breaks, every witness

svg.text: Breaks lists the rows a mutation must make VIOLATED, with any constants the row sets; holds lists the properties it must leave holding, which is what "breaks it and nothing else" means. A theorem's hypotheses are its ASSUME clause, read from the proof module: the mutations it excludes. §10? marks a mutation proposal §10 does not name.

text.tspan: 4 · What each header found against its record, and how R1 took it
Proposed · R1, 2026.11.10, on the custodian's instruction to revise
The finding, as the module's header states it

svg.text: BudgetConserved is stated for an honest subtree, and that is a finding. §1 said the debit makes "the root's tally bounds the whole tree". The debit bounds what is allocated: a captured plane can sign more leases
than its budget, each to a different vehicle, and no single verifier sees more than its own. What survives capture is the honest parent's account and ADR-0063's per-governor bound
Every BudgetConserved row runs at Captured={}; M_NODEBIT breaks it there
Narrowed. §1: the debit bounds what is allocated across the tree, and what is issued in any subtree with no captured plane. §4: the chain check bounds what each lease may carry, and
not how many a captured plane signs; the Consequences say the same
ADR-0059 §1, §4, Consequences, §9; R1
Two mutations break two properties each. Proposal §10 says each property has a mutation that breaks it and nothing else. M_LASTLINK and M_TRUSTPLANE each break LeaseWithinChain and HavocPlaneBounded:
under capture, a lease outside the chain is, or can be, outside what the root voted
m-last-chain, m-last-root, m-trust-chain, m-trust-root: VIOLATED
Recorded in §9's module item

The autonomous plane is honest here. A captured plane is a havoc issuer (ADR-0059 §4): it can sign a lease under an intent that has ended, and no log of its own is evidence. So "live when its lease was granted" is a
claim about an honest plane, and §3's is a claim about the log of an honest one
The module's plane has no capture; a captured one is bounded by Federation's chain check
and Outstanding
Narrowed. §3: "This is a claim about an honest plane's log"; what bounds a captured one is the chain check and ADR-0063
An effect can follow its intent's end. EndLease is free, so a lease may outlive its intent. §1's predecessor is ordered before the effect, not live at it; ADR-0063 bounds how many follow
w-afterend: NeverEffectAfterIntentEnded VIOLATED
Narrowed. §1: "The predecessor is ordered before the effect and need not be live at it"
M_LASTINTENT, an addition to proposal §10's table: ADR-0050's rule, which ⟨Q4⟩ declined. It breaks no property. Its effect is that a commander who narrows cannot restore
m-last-restored: NeverRestored HOLDS; m-last-safe: Safe HOLDS
Recorded in §7 as ⟨Q4⟩'s reason

The one-vote rule is not in §3. §3's only rule on signing is that a replica signs a drop only if it has not heard that replica either. An honest replica that has heard neither of two others could sign both, and two
successors follow. What forbids it is §2's agreement: one entry at one log index, a step naming the membership it replaces
M_TWOVOTES breaks AtMostOneSuccessor (m-twovotes-amo, at MaxBallots=6); the deadlock
audit's bound for Membership
Taken. §3 gains it: an honest replica signs at most one step of a membership. Read as one vote with no second ballot, a split vote stalls the schedule for good: safe, and not live. A
Negative follows, and an open obligation: whether a split vote may be retried, which Membership.tla (no ballot, no view change) neither designs nor checks
ADR-0061 §3, Negative, Open obligations; R1

At the archetype the floor is redundant with the schedule. 7, 6, 5, 4 ends at the last size whose f is one, so removing the floor's guard changes nothing while the schedule stands. The floor binds a charter whose
schedule runs past it
m-below-archetype: Safe HOLDS under M_BELOWFLOOR; its breaking rows set
Taken. §4: at this schedule the floor adds nothing the schedule does not
Five replicas, not seven. The module runs one plane of five; §1's archetype is seven, tolerating two captured
Every row's constants; Schedule={5,4} by default
Recorded, not closed. §7: "Met for TLC and TLAPS at five replicas, and not at §1's seven"
ADR-0061 Status note, §7

Proposal §10 and ADR-0062 §5 cannot both be read literally. §10: after a lease ends "the only effects are hold and the seating's terminal behaviour". §5 keeps a beacon, and ADR-0065 §2 with ADR-0015 counts a
transmission as an effect. The module states ExpiryGrantsNothing of entries and terminal acts, and bounds the beacon in AlonePermitsNothing: "It permits no actuation"
w-beacon: NeverBeacon VIOLATED; M_BEACONUNCOUNTED breaks AlonePermitsNothing
Taken. §5: the beacon is an effect; §10's sentence is true of actuation and is read that way

M_ALONEACTS is drawn otherwise than proposal §10 draws it. §10 has the alone governor permit one local entry. Since a permit needs a live lease, the guard that stops it is the ending, and the mutation removes
that: going alone does not end the lease
m-alone-alone: AlonePermitsNothing VIOLATED
Not a finding against the record. §11 names M_ALONEACTS among what Alone.tla meets
1. §3's governor rule names only leases. Read literally, a captured plane can admit ordered entries without limit and an honest governor carries them out unaccounted
M_ORDEREDFREE breaks both per-governor properties under a captured plane, neither under an
honest one
Taken. §3: the governor's account charges ordered entries as well as leases. ADR-0067 R1: FD10's governor clause follows
2. §4's argument names the last watermark before the revocation. A watermark covers one segment and is not cumulative, so it must read: that no watermark ordered before the revocation covers
The property as stated and proved: a charge is released by a pre-revocation watermark only
Taken. §4's argument reads so

3. The stop is load-bearing. A watermark ordered after the revocation releases a charge whose lease may have produced effects since; a hearer that released it and went on granting breaks the bound. The same
watermark carries the fence
M_NOSTOP breaks both effects bounds, and HavocPlaneBoundedInEffects holds
Taken. §4: "That stop carries the bound"
4. The strict form makes KUp a capacity of KUp − 1. KUp = 1 grants nothing, and a lease whose count is KUp or more can never be granted. Neither is stated
w-k1-nogrant: NeverGranted HOLDS at KUp=1 MaxCount=1
Taken. §3: kUp is at least 2, and a lease of count K_up or more is never granted

The premise and what this is not. NoGrantPastExpiry rests on the named ASSUME ClockPremise: captured and slow replicas together are fewer than a certificate. A declared bound with a premise about time,
not a safety theorem; Outstanding carries the bound with no such premise
m-tooslow-grant: VIOLATED at Slow={"r2","r3"}; m-tooslow-nofail HOLDS with the
premise true
Taken. §4: with the premise false this bound fails (M_TOOSLOW), and ADR-0063's still holds
ADR-0064 Status note, §4; R1

The residual. Overdue is by the governor's own clock, so EntryEndsAtExtent's third clause is about gclock and not now. A slow governor clock can stretch the entry in progress, only when the plane's ticks have
also stopped reaching it
w-stretched-slow: NeverStretched VIOLATED at GovClass="slow"; HOLDS sound and fast
Taken, on the custodian's decision of 2026.11.10: §5 defines overdue by the governor's own clock and shows the residual; NoStretchUnlessSlow says nothing else reaches it

A finding on §2. The first rule on a vote (never sign a tick ahead of your clock) carries no property: a tick ahead only subtracts. The second (no grant while the next tick is due) carries NoGrantPastExpiry. The first is
availability, ADR-0032's side
The module's header
Taken. §2: "The second rule carries §4's bound, and the first carries availability"

§1's sentence is false read literally. A peer relays certified facts, leases among them: a vehicle whose lease reached it by relay is permitted because of an item received from a peer. PeerAddsNothing ranges
over what a peer originates; a certified lease is the plane's act
w-relayedlease: NeverPermitUnderRelayedLease VIOLATED
Corrected. §1 ranges over what a peer originates, and adds "so is the same request with any subset of those items" (NarrowsInReceived)

What the labels guarantee. The receiver adds untrusted and the topic's name, so those two survive a captured sender. §3's "cannot remove any" holds of an honest governor, and a captured one is the case in which it
matters
M_SENDERLABEL breaks ReceivedIsUntrusted; w-labellow: NeverSenderLabelledLow
VIOLATED
Corrected. §3: an honest sender's governor adds names and removes none; what survives capture is the two names the receiver adds
1. §4's interlock omits that the act names this vehicle. Without it, one act fires once on each vehicle, since unused is each governor's own record
M_ANYVEHICLE breaks UsedOnce (and the conjunction)
Taken. §4: the interlock checks that the act names this vehicle

2. "With no link there is no irreversible effect" is true of the order, not the effect. An act that crossed the link before it was cut is still delivered and fires inside FreshT, and a governor cannot know the link is cut.
Freshness bounds it
w-aftercut: NeverFiredAfterCut VIOLATED; M_NOCONTACT breaks OrderedInContact
Taken. §4: an act is ordered only while the plane is in contact; Negative: with no link no irreversible effect can be ordered
ADR-0066 §4, Negative; R1
3. "Aged" is measured in the plane's ticks, and a captured plane can stop ticking. NoOlderThanDeclared is a statement about ticks and says nothing of duration, which is the watchdog's
M_LATEFIRST breaks NoOlderThanDeclared
Taken. §4: "Aged is a count of the plane's ticks"; duration is ADR-0064 §5's

text.tspan: 5 · What each module abstracts, and the constants TLC ran it at
Default constants, from the results file (rows may set others)
What is abstracted, from the header

svg.text: One chain of three planes, r → a → b, the root honest (ASSUME CapturedNotRoot). Four of §1's fields: seated, alphabet (a set), budget (a number) and fence; labels, bundles, ttlMax, countMax and expiry have the shape of the first two. One fence value per link. A commit certificate is unforgeable; verifiers are honest; a presented lease is any entry at any epoch. No re-seating. Membership is Membership.tla's

Every effect is reversible: an irreversible one is Release.tla's. Time is nondeterminism: an intent ends by EndIntent, whichever of expiry, revocation and a fence it was. An intent has envelope and budget; expiry and task have their shape. ADR-0050's live lease and live peer are not modelled. The autonomous plane is honest: a captured one is Federation's and Outstanding's

Five replicas, one plane, and not §1's seven. The captured are within the floor (ASSUME CapturedWithinFloor). PBFT is abstracted to its certificate: no view change, primary or message delivery. Whether a replica has "not heard" another is not modelled: an honest replica may sign any drop but its own, more than §3 allows. A step's ticks and a smaller membership's budget are not modelled. No action adds a replica

One vehicle, one governor, one stack. "Hears its plane" is a flag and GoAlone is free: the clock is PlaneClock.tla's. One local and one ordered entry; the count is a constant. EndLease stands for every ending but going alone and a fence. Reports are Peer.tla's. Reaching a safe state is physics

No clock: no variable or guard is a time, so a cut link, a late watermark and one never delivered are the same actions taken or not. Three lease slots, reclaimed, so leases over a behaviour are unbounded and at most three outstanding. Two honest governors. A watermark is one lease's coverage. A fence ahead of a watermark subtracts and is not modelled. Reports and ticks are not charged

text.tspan: · GovClass = "sound" · P = 2 · Base = 0 · D = 1 · MaxExtent = 1 · MaxNow = 7 · MaxTick = 4

svg.text: Discrete time: now in whole units, P units a tick period. No clock rates and no margins (folded into each clock's class: sound, slow, fast, captured), and nothing of a real clock's drift; ADR-0032 defers a timed automaton. A certificate is one atomic step, with no ballot, primary or view. One intent, one governor, one lease flag, one entry at a time; the lease's ttl is not modelled. Going alone is urgent. An extent is a number of ticks

One receiving governor, its lease, and one honest sender. The radio is the adversary's: any report on any topic with any labels can arrive. Three requests (act, egress, gated) and three topics. Sends recorded by digest, and the lease's end, are not modelled: live only rises. Whether a report is read is not modelled. Mesh.tla is neither edited nor extended

One commanded plane, one autonomous plane, two vehicles, one person, one agent, one irreversible entry. Ticks are numbers in the log, not a clock. The interlock is the only check relied on: an agent's act may be ordered and the autonomous plane may originate any act, so FD5, FD6 and FD9 are not assumed. The roster's quorum is one action; a void before the effect is not modelled

text.tspan: TLC is bounded, and no larger run exists

svg.text: Every row runs at the small constants of section 5. No -medium run at the records' placeholder values exists for any module
(spec/README.md, method step 3), and no simulation at larger bounds.
The proofs are not bounded by constants, but they are of the modules, and every module abstracts (section 5).

text.tspan: 52 LS4 steps, and a prover with two known unsound cases

svg.text: 52 temporal steps (7, 5, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 10) rest on LS4, "whose answer no checker confirms". None of the eight is re-encoded in
Lean (ADR-0053's route).
The scan looks for the prover's two unsound cases and finds no capture and no renamed difference; it lists the binder-case
candidates for reading. A certified proof is not a verified one.
No reference addendum: every record's reference item is "Not met". No test restates these properties and no trace is replayed
through them.
"A proof of these modules would be of the modules: no refinement to running code exists anywhere in the corpus" (proposal §10;
ADR-0067 §7: "Not met: no entry is written". No gate runs; the stage is not shown monotone in what a vehicle received from
peers (NarrowsInReceived is the module's, not the stage's).
No floor is ratified, so nothing here can be in force (ADR-0067 §5).

text.tspan: ADR-0061: PBFT not read, a round not measured

svg.text: "PBFT is read", and §2's three recalled statements sourced or corrected: not met. PBFT is abstracted to its certificate.
A measured round among seven over a deployment's radios: not met; the only figure is a simulated 412.3 ms among 20.
Five replicas modelled, not seven; a split vote's retry is neither designed nor checked.

text.tspan: ADR-0064: the arithmetic not in Lean, and time is discrete

svg.text: The two rules' arithmetic, transcribed and proved as mechanism/lean/Topak/Clock.lean does for the subtracting interval:
not met (R1).
No clock rates, no margins, no drift. "The timing budget is only partly expressible in TLA+" (ToO §11.3); ADR-0032 defers a timed
automaton.
No R1 row. §6 still reads "Each bound in §1 names a property of a module that exists. Not met: no module is written", though
eight now exist.
"Each row is read against ADR-0045's test": not met. Four rows are trust roots whose identity nothing issues (its Findings, 1).
